description: Permanently deletes one backup; this cannot be undone. A backup that is queued for restore or being exported cannot be deleted. For the only remaining copy of a world the call is refused with requiresConfirmation; ask the user, then repeat with confirm true.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.

confirm.description: true only after the user confirms deleting the last copy.

name: deleteBackup
title: Delete a backup
